edges.description: Interstitial fibrosis, a prominent and prognostically important feature of the human disease, does not develop in this model.

nodes.description: ALPK3 is an atypical alpha-kinase that sits at the sarcomeric M-band, where it organizes myomesins and the machinery that turns over sarcomere proteins, including MuRF E3 ubiquitin ligases and SQSTM1/p62. The node is deliberately scoped to the M-band. Two further claims are contested and are therefore not asserted here (see the discussion alpk3_pseudokinase_controversy): whether ALPK3 has catalytic activity at all, and whether it also occupies the nuclear envelope, which one group reports and another, using endogenously tagged protein, did not observe. The M-band localization and the proteostatic role are agreed on by both sides of that dispute.

evidence.snippet: In heterozygous ALPK3 PTVs, hypertrophy is typically apical or concentric, LVOT obstruction is uncommon (~4% overall), and systolic function is preserved in most.

nodes.description: Non-sustained ventricular tachycardia at baseline in about a third of heterozygous carriers, a rate comparable to sarcomere-positive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

evidence.reference_title: Alpha-protein kinase 3 (ALPK3) truncating variants are a cause of autosomal dominant hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
evidence.snippet: non-sustained ventricular tachycardia (31%) at baseline similar to SP+
